title: Flow-Lenia digestion ecology: does predator E survive when the digestion product gates only part of the growth field?
summary: Variant of 20261028T0344-c62-flow-lenia-ecology-s-claim where q/(q+K_q) multiplies only a subset of the predator's kernels and the rest run at the fed gain. Screen which subsets still kill starved predators, then run the ecology (S, X twin, D, per-predator cut) in the smallest such subset. Note for 20261028T0600-c64-review-cips-consumer: its limitation misstates one number; at y2 0.03 (seed 31, dt 0.25) q>0.5 covers 865-917 px at t=500-1000, against 1175-1182 px at y2 0.003, so less eating gives more consumer area.
